basis: HD-ZIP IV L1-identity TF (reciprocal best BLAST hit of AtATML1, 72% over 768 aa); epidermis snRNA cluster in Song 2023 (iv:5, 0.19 vs 0.005); named as epidermis marker in Huang 2026 Fig 1 dotplot but absent from its DE tables.

Cutin/suberin sn-2 GPAT (RBH of AtGPAT4); cross-study: Huang 2026 hook "exodermis-like" cluster 0.41 vs 0.07 (a shoot has no exodermis: cuticle-producing outer epidermis), Song 2023 air-side epidermis spots (ii:4, iii:10) and snRNA iv:5. In roots it marks the suberized exodermis (Canto-Pastor 2024), so not for root data.

Fatty-acid elongase KCS (best Arabidopsis hit KCS11) for cuticular wax/suberin precursors; cross-study: Huang 2026 "exodermis-like" in hook (0.42 vs 0.10) and hypocotyl (0.43 vs 0.09), Song 2023 air-side epidermis spots (ii:4, iii:10) and snRNA iv:5. Root exodermis gene in Canto-Pastor 2024.
HD-ZIP I TF (ATHB13-like), ethylene/ACC-response regulator (Huang 2026 CRISPR ja1); enriched but not specific in epidermis in Huang 2026 (pct.2 0.23-0.37) and Song 2023 snRNA iv:11 (0.64 vs 0.23).

R2R3-MYB36 (reciprocal best BLAST hit of AtMYB36, 54% over 367 aa) that activates Casparian-strip genes in Arabidopsis root endodermis (Kamiya et al. 2015 PNAS); hypocotyl endodermis-like cluster 0.32 vs 0.02 (Huang 2026 Table S3). Conflict: Solyc04g077260 (blind-like3), listed as SlMYB36-like in the tomato root review, matches AtMYB36 only over the MYB domain.

Casparian strip membrane domain protein; pCASP1::CASP1-GFP in tomato root endodermis (Li et al. 2018 Front Plant Sci, as cited by Huang 2026 and Canto-Pastor 2024). In hypocotyl only claimed in the Huang 2026 dotplot (not in DE tables); whether hypocotyl endodermis forms a Casparian strip is not shown. NCBI names this locus "CASP3-like": compare by ID.

CASP family (NCBI symbol "casparian strip membrane protein 1"); endodermis marker by family function in roots; hypocotyl only claimed in the Huang 2026 dotplot; in the Kajala 2021 MZ (meristematic zone) TRAP list, not EN.
CASP family; endodermis marker by family function in roots; hypocotyl only claimed in the Huang 2026 dotplot; in the Kajala 2021 MZ TRAP list, not EN.

2OG-Fe(II) oxygenase from a root-specific, highly expressed gene; promoter-uidA in mature root cortex (Jones et al. 2008 Funct Plant Biol). Conflict: in the Kajala 2021 exodermis (EXO) TRAP list; cited for hypocotyl cortex by Huang 2026 but not in its DE tables.
source: 10.1093/hr/uhag044; 10.1016/j.cell.2021.04.024; Jones et al. 2008 Funct Plant Biol

basis: Polyol/monosaccharide transporter (best hit AtPLT5; not PLETHORA); hypocotyl cortex DE 0.34 vs 0.13 (Huang 2026); broad in Song 2023. Weak; the only data-derived cortex gene.

Sieve-element occlusion protein (SEO family, best Arabidopsis hit SEOB; SE-specific in Solanaceae, Ernst et al. 2012 PNAS); cross-study: Huang 2026 hypocotyl "procambium" 0.66 vs 0.03 (a developing-SE cluster) and Song 2023 Stereo-seq vascular cells (i:4) and snRNA phloem (iv:15, 0.44 vs 0.11). Nuclei data capture developing SEs only.
Sieve-element occlusion protein B; cross-study: Huang 2026 hypocotyl "procambium" 0.55 vs 0.01, Song 2023 Stereo-seq vascular cells (i:4) and snRNA phloem (iv:15), Kajala 2021 phloem (PH) TRAP list.

Phloem protein 2 lectin family; cross-study: top gene of Huang 2026 hook "cortex" (0.65 vs 0.03, a phloem cluster) and hypocotyl "procambium" (0.52 vs 0.04), Song 2023 Stereo-seq vascular (i:4) and snRNA phloem (iv:8, iv:15), Kajala 2021 PH list. SE vs CC unresolved.

HMA-domain protein (best Arabidopsis hit NAKR2; AtNaKR1 is a companion-cell protein); cross-study: Huang 2026 hook "cortex" (phloem) 0.61 vs 0.05, Song 2023 snRNA phloem iv:8 (0.83 vs 0.13) and Visium vascular spots. Possibly companion cell.

Dof TF; Arabidopsis HCA2/DOF5.6 marks procambium/phloem (Guo et al. 2009 Plant Cell), but tomato orthology is a tie with Solyc03g112930. Song 2023 snRNA phloem iv:15 (0.42 vs 0.06), Kajala 2021 vascular (V) list; Huang 2026 cites it for hook "phloem" (a G2/M cluster) without DE support.

Clade III SWEET sucrose exporter, called SWEET11 by Huang 2026 but its best Arabidopsis hit is SWEET10 (not an RBH of SWEET11); Kajala 2021 PH TRAP list; not in Huang 2026 DE tables or Song 2023. Possibly phloem parenchyma.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (reciprocal best hit of AtCESA8/IRX1); cross-study: Song 2023 snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.87 vs 0.08) and xylem spots ii:8, Kajala 2021 vascular (V) list, Canto-Pastor 2024 xylem; claimed in the Huang 2026 hypocotyl xylem dotplot. Also in fibers.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (reciprocal best hit of AtCESA4/IRX5); cross-study: Song 2023 snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.88 vs 0.09) and xylem spots ii:8 (0.51 vs 0.02), Kajala 2021 V list, Canto-Pastor 2024 xylem; claimed in Huang 2026 dotplot. Also in fibers.

Papain-like cysteine protease of tracheary-element autolysis (best hit of both AtXCP1 and AtXCP2; Avci et al. 2008 Plant J); cross-study: Song 2023 snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.41 vs 0.01), Kajala 2021 V list, Canto-Pastor 2024 xylem; claimed in Huang 2026 dotplot.

VND-clade NAC master regulator of vessel differentiation (best tomato hit of AtVND1 and AtVND2/ANAC076; Kubo et al. 2005 Genes Dev); Song 2023 snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.32 vs 0.01); named VND2 by Huang 2026 (hook xylem) but not in its DE tables.

UDP-glucuronate decarboxylase for xylan synthesis; cross-study: Song 2023 snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.59 vs 0.12) and xylem spots ii:8 (0.35 vs 0.03), Canto-Pastor 2024 xylem; claimed by Huang 2026, not in its DE tables.

Cinnamyl alcohol dehydrogenase of monolignol synthesis; cross-study: Huang 2026 hypocotyl xylem 0.35 vs 0.07, Song 2023 snRNA xylem iv:19 (0.83 vs 0.31) and xylem spots ii:8. Also in other lignifying cells.

4-coumarate:CoA ligase of phenylpropanoid synthesis (ITAG4.0 model; UniProt A0A3Q7GIB5 is a different, RING-domain model); Huang 2026 hypocotyl xylem 0.46 vs 0.23 and Song 2023 iv:19, but also in other clusters.

Class III HD-ZIP (best hit ATHB-14/PHB; Huang 2026 called it ATHB-9/PHV); in Huang 2026 hook and hypocotyl "xylem" (0.26 vs 0.05-0.10) and Song 2023 snRNA procambium iv:6 (0.51 vs 0.20) and shoot primordia. Procambium-to-xylem precursors; use with other procambium genes.
APC/C activator CDC20 (reciprocal best hit of AtCDC20.1), G2/M; cross-study: top gene of Huang 2026 hook "phloem" (0.29 vs 0.05, a G2/M cluster) and Song 2023 snRNA iv:18 (0.80 vs 0.05).
Mitotic B-type cyclin (best hit AtCYCB2;4), G2/M; cross-study: Huang 2026 hook "phloem" 0.30 vs 0.02 and Song 2023 snRNA iv:18 (0.74 vs 0.04).

Histone H2A.1 (UniProt P25469); top gene of Huang 2026 hook "procambium" (0.79 vs 0.32, an S-phase cluster) and of Song 2023 iv:20, but high background; whether it is replication-dependent is not verified.
